resources.string: Opens zoom dialog. Zero zoom value means zooming by width.
Rotates the document 90 degrees clockwise. Long click rotates counterclockwise.
Opens the crop dialog. Values are relative to the page size. A long click on plus or minus changes the value by 10%. Negative values add margins.
1. Open document (zoom by width by default)
2. Select appropriate orientation: portrait or landscape
3. Crop borders, text size will change according to the borders (if zoom by width specified)
Opens page layout dialog. On reading comics or viewing books with images you could select appropriate page layout.
Opens External Dictionary. Choose appropriate Dictionary application in Settings.
Tap zones allow user to link different parts of device screen to commonly used commands. There are 3x3 cells where user could define actions for short (top label) and long (bottom label) clicks.

Allow user to export bookmarks (for all books or for current one). Bookmarks are exported to xml file with the name of opened book + [bookmarks.xml or all_bookmarks.xml] suffix. This option is available at Bookmarks screen menu.
